scene noonsky
I’m minding my own business when, suddenly, my phone rings.
And while this would not be anything worth noting on its own, I figured I’d let you know since Kirin is the one calling and that probably means I’m going to have sex.
: Hey.
: Hi! What are you doing right now?
: Castrating myself. Sorry to ruin your plans for the day.
: Can I keep what’s lopped off as a souvenir? A memento of all the great times we once had?
: Sure. Just make sure you split the memento with Noriko since she never got to have actual sex with me.
: Bad decisions aside, come meet up with me.
: But you just said “bad decisions aside” and that is very obviously a bad decision.
: Why is it a bad decision? What is that supposed to mean?
: It’s supposed to be an acknowledgment of how improper our relationship is. But I guess that wouldn’t click for someone who can’t grasp the concept of that.
: Oh, lame. Well, we’re going on a date and you can’t say no. Meet me near my place in an hour.
: I don’t like this assertiveness. Bring back the cute Kirin who says cute things and wears that very tight dress.
: Mmmmm no. Bye!
scene black
Kirin hangs up the phone and I guess I now have something (or someone) to do this afternoon.
Was I planning on getting laid today? No. But I never really plan on doing that since it always sort of happens no matter what I do. And today will be no exception.

which is good because i keep thinking about the clockless watch on my baby-like wrist//how the bones don’t fit like they did in her

WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO DO NOW??????
scene kirinmadyo1
: Oh, good! You made it.
: And only had one mental breakdown on the way.
scene kirinmadyo2
: As if you have anything worth being tormented over when you live in a world where everyone will still want to fuck you no matter what you do.
: You have no idea how accurate that is.
: Also, aren’t you supposed to be weirdly in-tune with mental impairments and not the type to accuse someone of being too privileged to bypass them?
: You know, I’m really glad you mentioned tune, because that’s pretty relevant to what I wanted to do today!
: No, I will not teach you how to play the piano. Ask someone else.
scene kirinmadyo3
: You know how to play the piano?
: No — which is why I won’t teach you.
: Damn. I was actually a little impressed for a second.
: Well, you shouldn’t be. I am talentless and miserable and only good for inducing orgasms.
: Well, at least we have that in common. Now, come with me.
: Where?
: To wherever the fuck I want to go. It’s my date. And I literally just gave you a hint.
: Yes, but the only answer I can come up with in regard to that hint is a place I definitely don’t want to go.
scene kirinmadyo4
: Well, that’s too bad because it isn’t up to you!
: Kirin-
scene noonsky
: This way, Sensei! I’ve already called ahead and reserved a time-slot for us!
: You’ve had this planned the whole time?
: Mhm! I just really feel like singing today! And you’ve never gotten to hear my voice either! So, come on! It’ll be fun!
: What if I never showed up?...
: Then I’d just have to go alone!
: Or find another random boy who wants to come with me. But hey! Nothing bad ever happens in karaoke booths, right?
: Senseiiiii! Let’s gooooooo!~
scene black
She knows.
There’s no way she doesn’t.
But how did she find out?...
She and Karin aren’t the type who actually talk to one another now...are they?
And if they are talking, why does Kirin even care?
Is it just jealousy?
Is she only grilling me about this because she wanted to be there for it?
I don’t know...and she’s so busy dragging me down the road like an oversized doll that I don’t even have time to wrap my head around it.
My hands begin to sweat. She notices. She wipes hers off before repeating that same contact again.
She keeps doing it. Hand to hand. Skirt. Awkward stare upward. Hands again. I’m in trouble.
No. It’s not trouble. It’s jealousy. Hands again. Skirt.
: Something wrong, Sensei? You seem a little more nervous than usual.
: I’m fine.
I’m fine.
: You’re fine?
I’m fine.
: I’m fine.
I’m not fine.
But I should be fine because this is a thing I’m fine with now and it doesn’t matter if I hurt Karin since Karin is just a side character and I don’t need her to progress. Right, Pareidolia?
wrong.
Shit.
when you were younger, you loved cereal.
scene cereaaal
I did?
yeah. you loved the little toys that came in the little boxes.
and you were the type of spoiled brat who was never okay with only having one of them. so you wanted to collect them all.
That doesn’t sound like me.
you have no idea what you actually sound like since you’re always focusing on bone conduction rather than the product of your voice and the air.
What?
think of it like this, akira. the you inside of you is a different you from the you outside of you.
and the you outside of you isn’t as much of a bitch as the you inside of you.
Okay, but what does that have to do with cereal?
i’d have gotten to that part already if you hadn’t interrupted me.
I’m sorry. I’m a bad boy.
only because you keep focusing on bone conduction. but that’s beside the point.
you loved cereal. but cereal is bad for your teeth. it can turn them into liquid. and your mother wanted to protect you from liquid teeth.
your father had a sweet tooth as well. but his vice was candy, not cereal.
I don’t remember my father.
no one does.
I don’t remember my mother either.
yeah. well a mixture of childhood trauma and timeline fuckery will do that. BUT ANYWAY, CEREAL.
Sorry, Pareidolia.
even today, you want to collect them all.
and no matter how many times you tell yourself you don’t, you know you’re wrong.
you’ll regret that one day. but you’ll live in bliss for now, pretending to be a better man than you actually are — which isn’t so much of a man at all.
you’re just a little boy with a walk-in toy box. and if you want to play with something, you CAN.
Okay. I’m sorry for talking back, Pareidolia.
don’t apologize to me — apologize to kirin for almost raping her big sister.

scene kirinmadyo6
: Any preference, Sensei? Is there a certain genre you try to stick to when you come here with other girls?
: I don’t-
: You don’t come here with other girls? Really? Because that’s not what I heard, Sensei.

scene kirinmadyo7
: Oooooh! That’s what you meant!
scene kirinmadyo8
: Sorry. Guess I got a little ahead of myself there.
: Something wrong, Sensei? It’s not like you to be so uncomfortable in a dark room with a defenseless girl.
: And it’s not like you to beat around the bush instead of saying what you really want to say.
scene kirinmadyo9
: No. I guess it’s not, is it?
: I guess we’re both dealing with something we’re not really sure of how to handle then, huh?
scene kirinmadyo10
: Ahh...this is so annoying. I hate having to be the good guy.
: But having a story arc without some sort of hero in it just doesn’t make much sense, huh?
: We can’t both be villains this time, Sensei.
scene kirinmadyo11
: And it is for that reason that I must ask you what you did to my sister.
: You have to...
: You have to...ask me?
: You don’t already know?
: I know that something happened. And I know that she’s really beaten up over it. But all I have to work with is context.
: And the context that I do have, Sensei...it doesn’t paint a very good picture.
: This is the part where I tell you to hurry up and spit it out since we only have this room for two hours and I don’t have time to watch you hesitate for the next ninety minutes.
: Why do you even care?
scene kirinmadyo12
: What do you mean, why do I care?
: I mean you’re the same girl who routinely gets turned on by the thought of me treating everyone you know like human-sized tissues I can soak up my cum with before tossing aside.
scene kirinmadyo13
: Wha...since when?!
: Since I first met you. But you can go ahead and pretend you were never like that since I don’t want to ruin your “good girl” arc when it’s just getting started.
scene kirinmadyo14
: Wow. Okay. So that’s how we’re going to do this, huh?
: How else would you prefer? Because tricking me into thinking we were hanging out before luring me into a place I’m not comfortable with doesn’t exactly scream “friendly chat” to me.
: Did you stop to think that maybe me doing that should have given you the hint you needed to confess without me having to force it out of you?
: I did. But then you immediately started trying to force it out of me without giving me any time at all to tell you what happened on my own.
: Well, would you? Because you’ve had a long fucking time since shit happened to do just that and all you’ve done is leave me in the dark.
: I’m not sure. Maybe? Want to spend the next ninety minutes listening to me hesitate before finding out?
scene kirinmadyo15
: You’re spicy today. All that quarantining get you a little pent up? Is that why you raped my sister? Couldn’t hold back anymore?
: I didn’t rape your sister, Kirin.
scene kirinmadyo16
: Because my good boy would never rape someone! He’d just convince them that they want to have sex. Right, Aki-kun?
: Wait, you didn’t?
Ignore Her...
: Well...what the fuck’s she so beaten up about then?
: Have you not talked to your sister at all?
scene kirinmadyo17
: No, because she won’t fucking tell me anything! I had to find out from Miku that you two came here together! But ever since she came back, she’s seemed friggin’ traumatized!
: Aki-kun, what’s your childhood friend’s band called again? I wanna sing one of her songs.
: Oh, nevermind. Found it! Forgot she was an idol. I should’ve been one of those. Idols can get away with anything.
: Kirin...just because I didn’t do anything to Karin doesn’t mean I didn’t want to. That’s what she’s probably traumatized about.
scene kirinmadyo18
: But...nothing actually happened?
: No. I ran away like a little bitch after a failed and somewhat subconscious attempt at coercing her into taking her clothes off for me.
: Some girls just don’t understand what a catch you are, Aki-kun! It’s okay!
: You still like...touched her, though. Right?
: There was some grappling involved. We may have ended up on the floor.
scene kirinmadyo19
: So...the two of you came here together...you tried to get into her pants...brought her to the ground...and then ran away before actually getting into them?
: Yup.
scene kirinmadyo20
: Oh.
: Well, that’s not nearly as bad as I expected. But still, keep your hands off of Karin.
: I don’t think my putting my hands on her is much of an option anymore, to be honest. She basically told me she doesn’t want anything to do with me anymore.
scene kirinmadyo21
: Well...good for her, I guess. But it’s kind of fucked up that you even tried getting with her in the first place when you can use me for that stuff any time you want.
: There’s the Kirin I know.
: I never went anywhere. But where’s the Sensei I know? You’ve been fuckin’...weird all afternoon.
scene kirinmadyo22
: I’m right here.
scene kirinmadyo23
: Me too! I wanna see if you’ve learned any new tricks while I’ve been getting eaten by worms.
: Wha...is this seriously the time for this? I’m trying to, like...scold you and stuff.
: It’s nice that you’re trying to be a good sister for once. I’ve always thought you’re the cutest when you’re trying to do the right thing.
scene kirinmadyo24
: And now you’re just...saying stuff you know will get to me. That’s not fair.
: You know...
: If you had been there with us, I don’t know if I’d have ever touched Karin at all.
scene kirinmadyo25
: Can I really use you “any time I want,” Kirin?
: Can I use you right now?...
: Will you get off from being fucked in the same spot where I almost took your big sister?
scene kirinmadyo26
: You’ve always wanted to...explore with her, haven’t you? Are you just pretending to be mad because I almost took that opportunity from you?
: You’re being too spicy now. I don’t like this.
: Why not?

scene kirinmadyo27
: I get that shit’s been hard or whatever. But if that’s the truth, I want to see that. And all I see right now is some douchebag trying to talk his way out of trouble.
: I know I’ve probably said some shitty things before...and I even probably meant them in the moment, but...
